# Release Notes: v1.0.8

> This file is the source of truth for the GitHub Release body.
> The release workflow (`.github/workflows/release-android.yml`)
> copies this file's contents as the Release body via `body_path`.

## Reliability

- **Wrong-day writes eliminated** — every counter tap, manual entry, and
  End Day now derives the tracking date from the clock at the moment of
  the mutation, instead of a value cached by a 30-second poll. Taps
  spanning midnight, a custom day-start hour, a daylight-saving
  transition, or a time-zone change are always recorded on the correct
  day, and the UI transitions to the new day in the same step
- **Counter taps blocked until the profile sync completes** — the app
  no longer guesses the day-start hour while the user profile is still
  loading (Android uses a 12-second fallback so offline remains usable)
- **History pagination made deterministic** — "Load older" resumes from
  the exact last document of the live window instead of a date cursor,
  so boundary dates split across the live-subscription limit no longer
  produce duplicate or missing rows; deleted cursor documents fall back
  cleanly and paging always makes forward progress
- **GDPR data export fixed** — the export previously shipped with an
  empty daily-history section because it ordered by a non-existent
  field; all day records now appear, across all pages, exactly once
- PWA offline navigation restored with a versioned shell fallback, plus
  service-worker update regression tests

## Correctness

- Monthly trend comparisons now round half-up (matching the Android
  client), with contract fixtures for non-integer boundaries
- Historical financial semantics protected: changing the current unit
  price does not reprice past months; historical snapshots keep their
  stamped prices

## Security

- `@grpc/grpc-js` overridden to 1.14.5 inside the Firebase JS SDK to
  clear the `npm audit` high-severity advisory (web)
- No change to the authorization boundary: Firestore Security Rules and
  API key restrictions are unchanged, and App Check enforcement remains
  OFF (advisory provider setup only)

## Maintenance

- Platform migrations completed and tested: React 19, Tailwind 4,
  Vitest 5 (including a mock-registry repair so App Check tests
  exercise their assertions again), Kotlin 2.x time migration
- Web suite: 348 unit/contract tests, 63 Firestore emulator tests,
  lint, and production build all green
- Android: 189 unit tests, assembleDebug, and emulator instrumentation
  green; a 25-minute per-step CI timeout now auto-fails emulator hangs
